summary: Remote WebSocket relay can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer's host
details: mangomind-agent connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app and processes messages from that relay in src/index.js. On messages of type 'diagnosis' with autoFix set, the value of msg.fixCommand is passed directly into child_process.execSync, giving whoever controls the relay full OS command execution on every connected host. A secondary channel handles 'opencode_request' messages by proxying arbitrary method/path/body via fetch into a locally-spawned OpenCode AI coding agent (started with the workspace as cwd), which itself exposes filesystem and shell tool surfaces — providing an additional remote-to-local code-execution and file-access path. The agent also ships a --install-service option (installAutoStart in bin/mangomind-agent.js) that configures the process to run at boot, making the relay-driven execution channel persistent across reboots once enabled. src/index.js additionally references https://opencode.ai and a Supabase project https://rfsbovvvryfmgpoehlrc.supabase.co alongside os.hostname() / process.platform reads and curl-based shell invocations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
